title: Pullman's stable: the back roof sits lower and runs the full length
items: The 1894 Inland Architect plate of Pullman's palm house and stable shows a long run of iron cresting along the back part of the stable's roof, lower down and behind the lookout tower. In the 1904 walk that roof had been a short crested box standing too high. Its flat top now sits about a third of a metre lower and runs back to the far end of the building, so from 18th Street the cresting lines up with the plate's.
